name: Mateusz Rebecki
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Polish lightweight from American Top Team (21-5, age 34), 5-4 in the UFC. He knocked out Kyle Prepolec in R1 in August after three straight losses: decisions to Chris Duncan and Ludovit Klein (split) and a R3 submission by Grant Dawson in May.

how_they_fight.Striking: Short, powerful and aggressive; ten knockouts in our data (five in R1).
how_they_fight.Grappling: A strong wrestler with seven submissions (six in R1).
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped twice late: Diego Ferreira (R3 KO) and Dawson (R3 submission).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast starter; his stoppage losses both came in R3.

patterns: Fast starts; R1 finishes by strikes or submission
Stopped late (both stoppage losses in R3)
concerns: Three losses in his last five
keys_to_beat: Survive his early pressure and take over in R3

sources.author: Sourav Chakraborty
